scope: 15 existing reference_evidence_pointer_limit uncertainties only; associated-profile conflicts at 13110 and 13225 remain separate.
method: Direct reread of all 15 complete frozen parent records including conditions, components/minimum_realizations, every member adoption and requirements, relations, profile_activation and effects. Earlier directly read full candidate closure and frozen member binding definitions remain the reference review. Each member below is adoption optional with requirements {}; each parent conditions is {}; associated profiles activate only on independent request evidence. No mandatory parent branch selects these member-specific meanings. Labels, effects and generic selected-actor/action-target co-realization do not supply a missing event or palette.
global_correction: The prior uncertainty label overstates a validator limitation. A validator capable of member pointers still must not promote an unselected optional child's property to parent whole_record. Parent-owned supported roles remain; unselected member-specific additions are excluded. Child selection would need explicit independently evidenced adoption and preserved binding guards, not inferred membership. Native base ID is not a child-selection branch.

parent_evidence: nested turns and repeated thickness connected to one unrolled surface
each coil shows the same front texture outside and the same reverse inside with a thin repeated edge separating adjacent turns
items.decision: Keep parent composition and texture. Exclude rolling action/acting hand from parent whole_record; connected static deformation and existing contact front do not require active rolling. Child action is selectable only through actual separate adoption; no validator bug established.

parent_evidence: path and rest point are connected
body weight or hand has plausible support
water bottle or bag has a stable held or resting position if selected
items.decision: Keep connected composition; body_pose only body-weight-support route, props only if selected. Exclude walking pause/resting action from parent whole_record. Rest point is spatial support, not proof of that ongoing event or park identity.

parent_evidence: the declared color stops connect in the stated positional order along one continuous background surface
surface shading remains readable through the spatial color transition
items.decision: Keep generic ordered continuous background gradient and readable shading. Exclude lavender/blue/coral identities and their particular ordering without independent selected palette. Parent declared stops refer to supplied colors; optional member does not itself select those colors.

parent_evidence: hand contacts opened flap or content
box is supported on floor or table
content and packaging occupy the same work area
items.decision: Keep direct contact, supported box, shared workspace and branch-specific opened flap state. Exclude active opening, home identity and mandatory table. Static contact with already opened flap/content is not opening action; floor/table and flap/content alternatives remain.

parent_evidence: one bent free flap joined to an attached sheet at a readable peel front
the peeled layer retains its front texture while a thin edge and differently lit reverse separate it from the exposed substrate
items.decision: Keep connected flap/front geometry, retained texture and differentiated reverse. Exclude actor pulling/peeling action from parent whole_record; a static peeled configuration is sufficient without optional actor member.

parent_evidence: one page visibly separates from the open book
fingers contact a reachable page edge
book is supported on lap or table
items.decision: Keep directly specified book/page state, finger contact and support. Exclude library setting, mandatory table and active turning as parent whole_record additions. A separated page at contacted edge can be a static configuration without the optional turning event.

parent_evidence: two plausible alternatives are simultaneously visible
hand or attention links the shopper to both
shelf, basket or stall supports the choice setting
items.decision: Keep shopper role and two-choice relational layout. Exclude specific comparing event/market identity from parent whole_record. Hand-or-attention does not require gaze, touch, price computation or decision outcome; member comparing is optional.

parent_evidence: the hand holds a garment between distinct groups
groups occupy supported surfaces or baskets
machine or destination basket is spatially reachable
items.decision: Keep parent explicit holding action and garment/groups layout. Exclude sorting event and before-wash narrative phase from parent whole_record. Supported distinct groups plus reachable destination do not force the optional temporal/sorting interpretation.

parent_evidence: source passage and destination desk are spatially connected
held object is supported by a visible hand
walking route to desk remains open
items.decision: Keep hand-supported held object and connected open route to desk. Exclude drink identity, office and returning/walking event from parent whole_record; an open walking route is not an actor walking on it.

parent_evidence: inside-outside threshold is identifiable
hand and umbrella show a plausible folding state
wetness is localized to the umbrella and weather-exposed area
items.decision: Keep threshold, umbrella folding state and local wetness. Exclude active folding event, just-entered narrative phase and current rain from parent whole_record. A plausible folding state can be static; child action is optional.

parent_evidence: hand and shoe form a plausible adjustment contact
doorway or entrance boundary is legible
the departure item has a stable location near the person
items.decision: Keep adjustment contact and entrance/nearby departure-item layout. Exclude before-leaving-home narrative, bag/coat identity and actual adjusting event beyond supported contact configuration. Generic departure item does not select optional bag/coat.

parent_evidence: the declared container surface retains its own bounded local color
the beverage or food regions retain their separate ingredient colors inside that container
the container color does not spread across the ingredient boundaries
items.decision: Keep bounded container/ingredient color separation. Exclude cobalt cup, espresso-brown beverage and cream identities without independently selected palette. Optional palette does not select its hues for generic declared colors.

parent_evidence: the hand and item form a coherent placement action
a cleared surface and an active small area coexist
an open walking path remains beside the active work area
items.decision: Keep direct placement action and cleared/active/open-path layout. Exclude tidying/room-cleanliness conclusion from parent whole_record; generic placing does not select optional tidying interpretation. Frozen member adult-domain deny remains if child actually selected; independent profile does not bypass it.

parent_evidence: pen contacts a form on a stable writing surface
visitor is positioned at a form station
a visible form and the service route occupy the same work area
items.decision: Keep pen/form contact, supported writing station and visitor role. Exclude completing/writing event and before-counter narrative from parent whole_record; pen contact and visitor position do not force optional writing/completion. No readable personal data.

parent_evidence: machine door is open and accessible
cloth, hand and basket follow one reachable transfer path
basket sits stably near the machine
items.decision: Keep accessible open machine, cloth/basket and reachable transfer layout. Exclude washer identity, directed removal and actual moving-laundry event from parent whole_record. Reachable transfer path does not force optional event or hand-cloth touch.
